purpose: Perform the separately guarded PC-CROP control-host cutover required by #3785 on the already attested Docker Compose Caddy edge, with exact DNS and pinned SSH preconditions, narrow mutation, live acceptance and automatic rollback.
requiredInvariants: The workflow runs only from an owner-authored exact-main push that changes the authorized cutover workflow and refuses concurrent production workflows.
Control DNS must have exactly one canonical A record and no AAAA record by exact dig RR-type evidence before SSH.
Production SSH must match the already attested pinned host fingerprint; the SSH pin is never changed.
The preflight must prove one running Compose web container and one running valid Compose Caddy container in the same project and protected working directory.
Only the production environment gate PC_CONTROL_HOST_ENABLED, the bound Caddyfile and the web container may change.
The web service is recreated with --no-deps, --no-build and --pull never and must preserve the exact pre-cutover immutable image ID and revision.
Caddy is reloaded inside the existing Caddy container; the Caddy image and every non-web project container ID must remain unchanged.
The Caddy candidate is validated offline with the already running immutable Caddy image and no network before the live file is changed.
The protected environment and Caddyfile are backed up before mutation; any local mutation failure restores both, and any public acceptance failure runs a second guarded rollback.
No DNS, database, migration, API, auth-mail worker, SSH trust anchor, image pull/build, secret, role, membership or user data is mutated.
No protected working path, Compose path, project name, environment value, Caddyfile body, container ID, private key or secret is posted to issues or artifacts.
GO and farmer-registration language remain forbidden until First Customer and all 9 of 9 role journeys pass.
acceptance: A valid TLS certificate for the exact control host is observed without bypassing certificate verification.
Ten consecutive live rounds prove control login readiness, public-route denial on the control host, parent staff redirect to control, parent staff API denial and exact primary-domain revision.
The primary domain returns no regression and the running web OCI revision remains the exact pre-cutover revision.
Failure inside the mutation or any live acceptance failure restores the original Caddyfile, original environment gate and original web image.
Successful cutover evidence is posted to #4159 and may then be referenced from #3785/#3072; it is not reviewer-MFA or 9-of-9 evidence.
